messages:
maria-sales: FYI — StratusEdge POC started this morning. They're seeing lots of 429s during the warmup traffic spike and their security team just pinged for SSQ answers. They want a mitigation plan + rough pricing for burst capacity by EOD.

sam-eng: Can you paste a sample 429 stack/logs? Is this auth or quota? :eyes:

maria-sales: quick curl from their app:```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
-H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx'
-d '{"model":"redwood-cred","input":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 2
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
```

june-ml: Looks like they're exhausting per-minute quota on the hosted tier. Could be continuous batching + short bursts. Are they hitting a single route or lots of small parallel requests?

maria-sales: parallel calls, multiple users doing warmup scripts. Customer said "we ramp from 0 to 200 rps in 2 minutes".

eli-ml: For immediate relief: 1) ask them to add exponential backoff + jitter (Retry-After handling) 2) route heavy warmup to a fallback lower-cost model variant 3) we can enable a temporary burst allowance from Dedicated pool if infra can approve.

infra-sre: oncall-bot just flagged capacity in us-west-2; we have some spare Dedicated slots but need a manual approval for cross-tenant burst. I'll escalate to infra leads. :up:

oncall-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-8792 — high 429 rates for stratusedge-poc (assigned to infra-sre).

maria-sales: Also they asked about pricing for that burst — want monthly estimate for short-term reserve (2 weeks) vs on-demand burst cost. Need a number to share with customer.

sam-eng: Ballpark: for the load they described, dedicated burst for 2wks is roughly +$2k-$4k depending on GPU profile. Exact calc depends on token/sec and sequence length. I'll pull metrics if you want a tighter quote.

june-ml: Quick config we can push today: increase per-customer in-memory token quota and enable KV-prefix caching for their prompt sets — reduces token generation downstream by ~30% on similar workloads. Will need a rolling config update; low-risk.

maria-sales: timeline? customer pushing for estimate + mitigation before their afternoon exec sync.

eli-ml: If infra approves the Dedicated burst we can route them in ~30 mins. If not, implement backoff + reduce concurrency — that's immediate. Caching/config push ~2-3 hours including verification.

carmen-se: I can take the SSQ items. Send the questionnaire link and I’ll fill the KMS/data-retention bits. Also need a sample DPA clause — finance already has a template.

maria-sales: share SSQ: https://internal.redwood.ai/ssq/stratusedge (internal) — @carmen-se please handle.

sam-eng: Action list: 1) infra-sre to approve temporary Dedicated burst (infra-sre) 2) customer to enable exponential backoff + lower concurrency (maria-sales -> stratus contact) 3) june-ml to push caching config (june-ml) 4) carmen-se to start SSQ answers.

infra-sre: Approved temporary burst. Routing rule created, will be active in ~20 mins. I'll post confirmation once traffic flips.

maria-sales: :thumbsup: Will tell them to hold off manual ramps until we flip routing. Also asking for their projected token lengths so Sam can firm up pricing.

sam-eng: Received projected sequences (avg 550 tokens, peaks 1600). With that, rough on-demand burst cost calc -> +$3.2k for 2 weeks with Dedicated small-gpu pool. I'll send a short spreadsheet.

maria-sales: please fire the spreadsheet to me and @carmen-se, I'll share with customer before their sync.

eli-ml: After routing flips, watch for any model fallbacks (we'll auto-route to verified variant if latency SLOs slip). If we see persistent 503/502s post-fix, notify eng-runtime.

maria-sales: thanks everyone — I'll update in 25m after the routing change.

infra-sre: Routing flipped at 1799991200 — monitoring now. Early metrics look good, 429s down ~85%.

maria-sales: amazing. customer confirmed lower errors and exec sync postponed. I'll loop back on SSQ and pricing later today. :relieved:
